Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Remote, US)

About the role
Example Health Co builds scheduling and billing software used by clinics across the United States. We are hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join a product squad that owns the patient booking experience, from the React front end to the Node.js services and PostgreSQL data behind it. This is a fully remote position open to candidates anywhere in the United States.

What you'll do
- Build and ship features across the stack in TypeScript, React and Node.js
- Design and evolve REST and GraphQL APIs that other teams depend on
- Own data models and migrations in PostgreSQL, with an eye on performance
- Improve our CI/CD pipeline, test automation and deployment on AWS
- Lead technical design for your squad's work and mentor less experienced engineers
- Partner with product and design to turn user problems into simple, fast interfaces

Required qualifications
- 5+ years of professional experience building web applications
- Strong TypeScript and React experience
- Experience building backend services with Node.js
- Experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database
- Experience deploying and running applications on AWS
- Experience with automated testing and CI/CD

Preferred qualifications
- GraphQL
- Terraform or other infrastructure as code
- Go
- Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry

Compensation and benefits
The base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $175,000 per year. We also offer medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) match, and a home office stipend.

Example Health Co is an equal opportunity employer.
